description: Transvaalbuurt 1921-1922 oriel rows (Retiefstraat 2-28, Tugelaweg 19-31): 18 m red-brown brick stair blocks of a ground storey and three upper storeys of flats, five axes: a window axis, a canted brick bay with white-framed three-light fronts through storeys 1-2 on a white console over a wide ground window, the stair axis with the portiek door and narrow stair windows, the mirror bay, a window axis; plain windows on the top storey; a cream gutter board at about 12.4 m on a short red-tile roof face carrying four white timber dormers with flat caps

match.note: 3DBAG eaves 12.5-13.3 m on Tugelaweg 19-31 and 12.8-14.8 m on Retiefstraat 2-28 (the dormers lift some pands), ridge 17.7-17.9 m, bouwlagen 5, BAG 1921-1922. The 18 m stair blocks only: Retiefstraat 4-8 and 16-20 (13.3 m) carry one bay and the corner pands (7.0-8.9 m) other fronts, and are left to a later variant

dormers.note: a cream gutter board at 12.35 m; four white timber dormers 2.7-2.9 m wide with flat overhanging caps, tops about 14.1 m, over the window and bay axes (Retiefstraat 10-14, 2023 strip)

door-centre.note: the portiek door on the stair axis (1.8 m with its frame, 8.4-10.2 m of the 18 m front)

roof.evidence: the strips show a short red-tile roof face over the gutter board carrying the dormers (Retiefstraat 2-28 2023, Tugelaweg 19-31); 3DBAG ridge 17.7-17.9 m behind it

rhythm.bays: window, canted bay, stair axis, canted bay, window
rhythm.identicalBays: no: the bays and the stair axis
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: window, wide window, portiek door, wide window, window | 1-2: window, bay, stair window, bay, window | 3: five windows
rhythm.symmetry: near symmetric about the stair axis
rhythm.groundFloor: flats; the portiek door on the stair axis
rhythm.roofline: a cream gutter board, a short red-tile roof face with four white flat-capped dormers

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2023 at 40 px/m, pavement 0.5 m over the strip foot: 18.0 m pand; axis centres 2.2, 6.2, 9.3, 12.45, 16.4 m; canted bays 2.95 m across with three-light fronts, lights 3.5-5.3 and 6.6-8.4 m, a cream head panel 8.4-9.2 m, a white console at 2.8-3.0 m over a wide ground window 0.6-2.05 m; portiek door 8.4-10.2 m; top-storey windows 9.4-10.95 m; cream gutter board 12.35 m; four white dormers, tops 14.1 m
strip.jpg at 40 px/m: 17.8-18.0 m pands with the same five axes, bays on axes 2 and 4, the stair door between them, gutter 12.0 m on the strip, four or five dormers to 14.3 m

schemaLimits: the house door beside the first window axis is not drawn (one door per front: the portiek door)
the stair windows are drawn as ordinary windows on the stair axis, not offset half a storey
a fifth dormer on some Tugelaweg pands is not drawn
notes: HELD (#154, 2026-11-01): authored and measured on Retiefstraat 2-28 / Tugelaweg 19-31, but no pand is placed. Every candidate scores edge NCC 0.01-0.13 against its strip (gate 0.15): the kit's casement-toplight panes and glazing band do not match the stone-mullioned, small-paned windows, and the four flat dormers cost ~80 tris a house so a 18 m house is 3.3k triangles (budget 3000). Fix the window kind and a cheaper dormer before this type can place.
